allow: PowerShell($d = Get-Content "outputs\\api_data.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $d.PSObject.Properties.Name; "--- profile keys ---"; $d.profiles[0].PSObject.Properties.Name; "--- tiers ---"; $d.tiers; "--- n profiles ---"; $d.profiles.Count)

PowerShell($d = Get-Content "outputs\\api_data.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "=== er_stats ==="; $d.er_stats | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; "=== er_metrics ==="; $d.er_metrics | ConvertTo-Json; "=== timings ==="; $d.timings | ConvertTo-Json; "=== graph_stats ==="; $d.graph_stats | ConvertTo-Json; "=== plugins ==="; $d.plugins; "=== llm_active ==="; $d.llm_active; "=== generated_at ==="; $d.generated_at; "=== pipeline_seconds ==="; $d.pipeline_seconds; "=== review_pairs count ==="; $d.review_pairs.Count; "=== sample review_pair ==="; $d.review_pairs[0] | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4)

PowerShell($d = Get-Content "outputs\\api_data.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $d.profiles[0]; "=== sample profile \(slim view\) ==="; $p | Select-Object entity_id,name,score,tier,tier_ur,filer,declared_income,lifestyle_income,household_id,household_members,household_declared,n_vehicles,n_properties,avg_bill,n_sources,n_accounts,annual_deposits,n_intl_trips,travel_spend | ConvertTo-Json; "=== components/weights/comp_names ==="; $p.components | ConvertTo-Json; $p.weights | ConvertTo-Json; $p.comp_names | ConvertTo-Json; "=== evidence[0..2] ==="; $p.evidence[0..2] | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; "=== timeline ==="; $p.timeline | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; "=== match_provenance ==="; $p.match_provenance | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; "=== graph nodes sample ==="; $p.graph.nodes[0..4] | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; "=== graph links sample ==="; $p.graph.links[0..2] | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3)
